linkedin:
Use Stripe Checkout so card data never touches your server.

Treat the webhook as the only source of truth for access, never the browser redirect. Verify signatures against the raw request body, make every handler idempotent because Stripe retries, store the customer and subscription IDs on your user row, and act on subscription status rather than on a single payment.
